$comment: GT-656 — declared retitles of gap TITLES, read by 49-validate-gap-id-allocation. A collision is exempt ONLY when an entry here reproduces BOTH titles exactly, so an exemption covers one retitle and never an id: a genuine collision landing on the same number still fails. Entries are classified active / spent / rot; rot is fatal, and an entry whose retitle has reached the base branch is SPENT and must be deleted. This array is empty and that is the healthy state — the registry is for retitles in flight, not a record of past ones. The history of a retitle lives in the row it changed and in git, which is where a reader looks for it.
